integrity: Exact finite formula and strict-convexity arguments; standard-library verifier checks 1777 independent identities/illustrations. Priority not independently established and numerical testing is not an infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Mutation-free well-mixed finite population, homogeneous affine contributor-dependent multiplier, positive parameters, exponential-fitness Moran or Fermi update; result does not imply mutation robustness or a change of relative fixation rankings. Population-size limit keeps group size and payoffs fixed.
title: A unique neutrality reversal in finite nonlinear public-goods games
